ev.q: During 2017–2023, CDC supported 2,278,743 PrEP initiations in 37 countries, 118.7% of CDC’s overall target for the 7-year period
CDC-supported PrEP initiations in 37 countries increased from 11,397 in 2017 to 856,816 in 2023
The majority of PrEP initiations in sub-Saharan Africa occurred among females (65.8%), whereas the majority in the other regions occurred among males
More than one half (64.0%) were female and 44.9% were aged 15–24 years.
Overall, CDC surpassed targets for PrEP initiations (118.7%) for the 7-year period.
In 2023, all four regions exceeded 100% of their annual target.
These initiations were also compared with CDC PrEP initiation targets to assess percentages achieved.
The largest year-to-year increases occurred in sub-Saharan Africa from 2020 to 2021 (220% increase)
